prepared_checkout_difference: none; the prepared amdpilot/j-b47ffc385754 branch was exactly at the recorded base commit
summary: The base reproduces the missing NCCL RAS integration and the candidate adds the requested collector, detector, scheduler lifecycle, metrics, logs, documentation, and focused tests. However, its socket client hard-codes a one-second read timeout. NVIDIA's NCCL RAS documentation states that STATUS may take several seconds while gathering job-wide communicator data, especially for large or unhealthy jobs. An independent protocol-compatible server returning valid JSON after 1.2 seconds was misclassified as a failed poll. This can produce false poll_success=0 crash signals in the exact degraded multi-node conditions the feature is intended to diagnose. The candidate tests pass because their socket mock responds immediately and do not cover a realistically delayed STATUS response. Live NVIDIA NCCL RAS behavior remains unavailable on this AMD/RCCL single-GPU node.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: the collector module does not exist at the recorded base. Evidence: reports/j-b47ffc385754/raw/base-import-failure.log
Candidate regression suite: 34 tests and 2 subtests passed using the checked-out source module. Evidence: reports/j-b47ffc385754/raw/candidate-unit.log

Independent protocol-compatible delayed STATUS case. The server accepted the candidate's SET FORMAT json and STATUS commands, then returned a valid response after 1.2 seconds. The candidate's one-second read timeout returned None and misclassified the valid response as poll failure. Evidence: reports/j-b47ffc385754/raw/adversarial-protocol.log
Candidate Python source compiled under the pinned interpreter and imported from /job/repo/python. No native source changed.
The exact candidate contains trailing whitespace in its retained unit-test log. This is minor and not the reason for request_changes. Evidence: reports/j-b47ffc385754/raw/environment-and-static.log

gpu_execution_evidence: The prepared runtime identified one AMD Instinct MI355X, Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2, RCCL/NCCL compatibility API 2.27.7, and no listener on localhost:28028. This establishes the architecture blocker but is not live NCCL RAS execution. Evidence: reports/j-b47ffc385754/raw/environment-and-static.log
remaining_counterexamples: A valid NCCL RAS STATUS response taking 1.2 seconds is reported as poll failure because RasSocketClient.read_timeout defaults to 1.0 second; NCCL documents that job-wide STATUS responses may take several seconds.
The candidate's immediate-response socket mock does not exercise delayed or degraded job-wide collection, so its passing regression suite does not establish the original runtime contract.
Live NVIDIA NCCL 2.28.7+ polling, two-node unresponsive/dead transitions, and TP=2 serving metrics remain unverified on the available AMD/RCCL 2.27.7 single-GPU environment.
remaining_limitations: Only one AMD Instinct MI355X was assigned; the required NVIDIA NCCL 2.28.7+ RAS endpoint and a second node/GPU were unavailable.
RCCL reports NCCL API compatibility version 2.27.7 and localhost:28028 refused connections, so no live RAS STATUS or crash-transition experiment was possible.
The deterministic tiny Llama serving fixture cannot substitute for NVIDIA NCCL RAS, multi-node failure detection, or semantic validation of this collector and was therefore not used as proof.
No C++ or other native source changed, repository-environment.json provides no native rebuild target, and no native rebuild was required.
Symmetric whole-collective hangs are intentionally outside this collector's divergence signal and remain assigned to the forward watchdog by the original contract.
